name: review-pack
title: Supplier master review pack
for_each: select id,code from masters where status <> 'retired' order by code

sections.title: Internal draft
sections.note: Review evidence and identity before approval. This is not a bank detail or payment authority.

sections.title: Chosen values and their evidence
sections.sql: select f.field,f.value,s.source_system,s.source_key,s.version,s.evidence_ref,f.reason from master_fields f join source_records s on s.id=f.record_id where f.master_id=$1 order by field

sections.title: Outstanding checks
sections.sql: select rule,issue from v_issues where master_id=$1

sections.title: Review history
sections.sql: select revision,actor,evidence_ref,note,created_at from reviews where master_id=$1 order by created_at

name: change-register
title: Supplier change register
for_each: select id,code from masters order by code

sections.title: Attributed decisions
sections.sql: select action,actor,detail,created_at from events where master_id=$1 order by created_at
sections.note: Actor names are recorded attribution. Database administrator activity is outside this log.
